text: Latent evolution models: one compact model for forward, inverse, tuning and uncertainty problems in particle accelerators.

text: Full physics simulations can fill the gaps, but they are slow.

text: So the field builds virtual diagnostics: fast learned models that tell us what the beam looks like where we can't look.

text: Forward: predict the beam downstream from what it looks like upstream.

text: Inverse: run that backwards, and recover the upstream beam, with error bars.

text: An encoder squeezes the fifteen images through a narrow bottleneck: a short list of numbers, called the latent vector, z.
